subject: [PATCH v2 1/5] nfsd: Report vetted delegated timestamps in GETATTR replies

2026-11-06.patch_summary: This patch fixes an issue in the NFS server where delegated timestamps were being overridden, causing incorrect times to be reported to clients. The override was undoing vetting that had already been done by the server, leading to issues such as reporting times older than the delegation grant or unclamped future times. The patch removes this override, ensuring that only valid and vetted timestamps are returned in GETATTR responses.
